title: Fundamentals of Survey Sampling
description: Covers principles of probability sampling, simple random sampling, stratified and cluster sampling methods, sampling frame construction, and estimation procedures used in NSS surveys.
_review_note: Reviewed from NSSTA TC 2024-25 p.12. Title cleaned from 'Fundamentals of Survey Sampling Techniques'.

title: National Accounts Statistics: Concepts and Compilation
description: Theory and practice of compiling GDP and GVA estimates. Covers 2011-12 base year series, supply-use tables, and MOSPI compilation methodology aligned with 2008 SNA.

title: Statistical Software Applications: R for Data Analysis
description: Hands-on training in R programming for government statisticians. Covers data wrangling with tidyverse, descriptive statistics, regression, and visualization with ggplot2.

title: Price Statistics and CPI Compilation
description: Methodology for Consumer Price Index compilation, sources of price data, weighting procedures, seasonal adjustment, and international standards (ILO CPI manual).

title: Data Quality Frameworks and Assessment
description: Introduction to IMF Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF), metadata standards, evaluation of source data adequacy, and internal consistency checks for official statistics.

title: Time Series Analysis for Official Statistics
description: Seasonal adjustment (X-13ARIMA-SEATS), trend estimation, index numbers, and composite leading indicators. Practical sessions using SAS and R.

title: Population Census: Concepts and Methodology
description: Houselist operations, census enumeration methodology, de jure vs de facto approach, post-enumeration survey design, and dissemination of census results.

title: SDMX Standards for Statistical Data Reporting
description: Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange (SDMX) framework, Data Structure Definitions, global registries, and applying SDMX for national statistical reporting to international organisations.
_review_note: Niche but real — appears in NSSTA intl. statistics module.

title: Use of Administrative Data in Official Statistics
description: Strategies for integrating administrative records (tax, civil registration, GST) with survey data. Covers record linkage, confidentiality safeguards, and quality assessment of admin sources.

title: Geospatial Data and GIS for Statistics
description: Application of Geographic Information Systems in statistical operations: delineation of EAs, GPS-based field operations, small-area estimation, and spatial data dissemination.
